description: The bar chart titled "Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks" compares the performance of two models—LLaMA-3-8B-it (blue bars) and Ours (Iterative RLHF) (orange bars)—across eight different datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis lists the datasets and metrics, including GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis represents the score in percentage, ranging from 0 to 80. For each dataset, two bars are shown side-by-side, representing the scores of the two models. In most cases, the orange bar (Ours) is taller than the blue bar (LLaMA-3-8B-it), indicating that the Ours model achieved higher scores. The highest scores are observed on the GSM-8K dataset, where both models score above 80%. The lowest scores are on the Chat-Arena-Hard dataset, where both models score below 30%. The chart visually demonstrates that the Ours model consistently outperforms the LLaMA-3-8B-it model across all evaluated benchmarks.
